meta.note: Single source of truth for every standalone calculator page that has its own page script (tools/*_page.js). Read by the All Tools catalogue, the category hubs, the home page, the calculators hub, the standalone pages' related sections and tests/internal_link_graph_test.js. An engine calculator is NOT listed here: its public page comes from the engine registry and tools/master_register.json.

fields.primaryCategory: slug of the category hub (tools/category_hubs.js) that always lists the tool
fields.secondaryCategories: hub slugs that list the tool only where the technical relationship is real
fields.category: master register category id (All Tools discipline)
fields.related: site-root-relative paths of approved related tools, shown on the page (6 to 9)
fields.inboundFrom: engine calculator page slugs whose Related section also offers this tool
fields.includeInAllTools: false only for a page deliberately left out of All Tools
fields.homepageFeatured: true adds the tool to the home page More tools list
